# Drive Right

> Austin-based car buying and negotiation service supporting buyers nationwide. The Drive Right plan is $395 USD one time for one model; Drive Right Pro is $695 USD one time for up to three models. Pricing, availability, and outcomes vary by purchase.

Updated: 2026-10-23

Drive Right is a service-area business. It does not operate storefronts in each metro. Public contact: hello@driverightcarbuying.com.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/): Overview of the service, plans, nationwide support, and how Drive Right compares vehicles and deal terms.
- [Car buying service](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/car-buying-service.html): Service scope, current fees, and buyer responsibilities.
- [How it works](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/how-it-works.html): Process, listed fees, buyer responsibilities, and current disclosures.
- [Plans and pricing](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/schedule.html): $395 Drive Right (one model) and $695 Drive Right Pro (up to three models), each a one-time service fee. Drive Right clients can upgrade to Pro for the $300 difference.
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/pricing.md): Current fees, inclusions, and purchase-cost exclusions in Markdown.
- [About](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/about.html): Founder Mason and the service approach.
- [Resource hubs](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/blog.html): Index of decision guides. Several older articles remain unpublished to search pending source review.
- [Texas local markets](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/texas-local-market-intelligence.html): Statewide service-area overview for nine Texas metros.
- [Policies](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/policy.html): Privacy, terms, and refund policy.

## Practical resources
- [Compare car quotes](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/compare-car-quotes.html): Free local worksheet for entered purchase costs, missing information and conditional incentives; no quote submission.
- [Compare complete new-car quotes](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/blog-buy-new-car-below-msrp.html): Written offers, rebate eligibility and whole-quote comparison.
- [Dealership add-ons](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/blog-dealership-addons-complete-guide.html): Questions about product cost, coverage and contract terms.
- [Used-car inspection checklist](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/blog-used-car-inspection-checklist.html): Buyer observations, title/history/recall sources and questions for an independent mechanic.

## Comparisons
- [Car buying services compared](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/compare-car-buying-services.html): Published fees, who negotiates, new or used coverage, refund terms and who pays each service for Drive Right, CarEdge, Delivrd, Car Pal, Automatch Consulting, Authority Auto, Costco Auto Program and Consumer Reports Build & Buy. Competitor facts checked 2026-10-18 on each company's own pages.
- [CarEdge alternatives](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/caredge-alternatives.html): CarEdge's Concierge ($999 per car search) and AI Buying Agent compared with Drive Right and other services, including how CarEdge says it makes money.
- [Delivrd alternatives](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/delivrd-alternatives.html): Delivrd's $1,000 Insta-Pay Deal Negotiation, its refund and change rules and its used-car pause, compared with Drive Right and other services.
- [Used car buying service](https://www.driverightcarbuying.com/used-car-buying-service.html): Drive Right searches and negotiates used and CPO cars for $395 or $695; Delivrd's used-car pause (checked 2026-10-23).
